Introduction

Kim HyunJin is a South Korean singer-songwriter under triangle ENM. She is the visual and leader of the girl group Loossemble. She is also a member of LOONA and its sub-unit LOONA 1/3, although the group is currently inactive. She was also a contestant on MIXNINE.

She released her solo single album “HyunJin” on November 17, 2016. She debuted in LOONA on August 20, 2018, with their debut mini album “[+ +]”. However, she parted ways with BlockBerryCreative after a legal dispute on May 9, 2023.

On June 11, 2023, it was announced that she signed an exclusive contract with CTDENM. On July 29, It was also confirmed that she would debut as a member Loossemble alongside LOONA members YeoJin, ViVi, Go Won, and HyeJu. On September 15th, 2023, she debuted as a member of Loossemble with a mini album of the same name.

On November 29, 2024, CTDENM announced that its exclusive contract with the Loossemble members had ended.

On December 4, it was announced that HyunJin would be releasing her first digital single "Thank You" on December 16.

Following Loossemble's hiatus, HyunJin is planning a solo career, as well as a band project with former cignature members Jeewon, Haeun, and Semi, and former Hashtag member Dajeong.

On July 16, it was announced that HyunJin is a part of the Studio USOG's program Another Day of Debut Training in collaboration with South Korea's Ministry of Patriots and Veterans Affairs which will form a project girl group for a musical festival in honor of South Korea's 80th Liberation Day in August. The group's name was later revealed to be TDYA.
